fixed.comparison: all 4 grids on same common central proper time, and last 3 on same longer common interval; no order from distinct intervals

bracket.rule: evaluate upper endpoint, retain lower from R4A2, update only mass-gated proxy labels; stop on unresolved or budget failure; no true threshold

controls.rule: eligible near-trapping proxy pairs require same class and mass drift <1% at both resolutions, not physical horizon evidence

positive.method: exact frozen R3B peak estimator; synthetic log-time oscillations with growing amplitude, independent artificial periods, no physical target. Clean recovery for core periods <=4.1 required; 5.2 stress case reported separately. Noise sensitivities reported without tuning.
